title: Where is the target relative to me?
description: Request the target in base_link. Positive x means ahead; positive y means left. The same world target has different coordinates when the robot turns.
steps: Inspect the actual TF tree panel: world → odom → base_link, plus sensor and target frames.
Look up target with base_link as the target_frame argument.
Report translation.x and .y with report_relative, then compare with the visible target marker.
hints: lookup_transform(target_frame, source_frame, Time()) maps source coordinates into the target frame.
Requesting odom instead would give world-aligned coordinates, not robot-relative coordinates.
lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time())

nl.title: Waar is het doel ten opzichte van mij?
nl.description: Vraag het doel in base_link. Positieve x is vooruit; positieve y is links van de robot.
steps: Bekijk de echte TF-boom en het target-frame.
Gebruik base_link als target_frame in lookup_transform.
Rapporteer translation.x en .y met report_relative.
hints: lookup_transform zet source-coördinaten om naar target_frame.
odom geeft wereldgerichte coördinaten, niet robotrelatieve.
Gebruik lookup_transform("base_link", "target", Time()).

odom fournit des coordonnées alignées sur le monde, pas sur le robot.

it.title: Dov’è il target rispetto al robot?
